'''Brad Bourque''' (also published as '''Brad Bouque''') is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 60th at [[2000 Texas State Championship]] on 6 May 2000, according to Brian Guthrie's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d692">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-tx-state-championship-director-s-reportd692/ tx-state-championship-director-s-report], DeckTech (Brian "Red 81" Guthrie, 8 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-tx-state-championship-director-s-reportd692/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Brad Bourque also finished 11th at [[December 1999 Austin tournament]] on 11 December 1999, according to Brian Guthrie's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d142">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-11-austin-tx-12-11-99-ecc-discussiond142/ austin-tx-12-11-99-ecc-discussion], DeckTech (Brian "Red 81" Guthrie, 11 December 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-11-austin-tx-12-11-99-ecc-discussiond142/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
